Name: Clarabelle the Blue Chicken
Author: deleted127110843
Description:
A revolutionary mod that uses Custom Companions to add a sleeping blue chicken to the animal shop after Shane's 8 heart event has been triggered.

Interact with her to get a little snippet of flavour text! Her name is Clarabelle.

Watch her mindlessly wander around the ranch and make cute little clucking noises! What could be better?

[b]Future Plans: [/b]Add JA support so that Clarabelle can follow the farmer around!

Downloads.Description:
